Markets.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to Rs 858 crore
Markets.summary: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% increase in second-quarter net profit to Rs 858 crore. This profit growth was driven by a lower bad-loan provision due to an improved gross non-performing assets ratio of 1.99%.

Markets.title: Portfolio Killers: 10 US stocks that wiped out up to 66% of investors’ wealth in 2026
Markets.summary: In 2026, The Trade Desk's shares plunged 65.75% from $37.96 to $13.00, making it the biggest loser on a list of wealth-destroying US stocks. This sharp decline left the digital advertising technology company with a market capitalisation of $6.1 billion.

Markets.title: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 10 stocks rally up to 100% in FY27 so far
Markets.summary: About 14 stocks in the Government of Singapore’s India portfolio delivered positive returns so far in FY27, with 10 rallying up to 100%. Meanwhile, nearly half of the stocks in the portfolio posted negative returns.

Markets.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results: Consolidated PAT rises 26% YoY to Rs 5,645 crore;  NII up 16%
Markets.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 26% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 5,645 crore for the second quarter. During the same period, its net interest income rose by 16% to Rs 8,459 crore.

Markets.title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for 10th straight week as markets slide: Is the worst over or more pain ahead?
Markets.summary: Foreign institutional investors dumped Indian stocks for the tenth consecutive week as the Nifty 50 index fell 2.4% to close at 22,600. Selling pressure intensified across the broader market, with the Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 plunging 5.6% and 7.3%, respectively.

Markets.title: Bitcoin hovers near $80,000 and Ethereum at $2,370 as macro uncertainty and weak institutional flows weigh on crypto markets
Markets.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $80,685 and Ethereum hovered near $2,370 as macroeconomic uncertainty and weak institutional interest weighed on the market. Major altcoins like XRP and Dogecoin also experienced dips amid substantial outflows from Bitcoin and Ether ETFs.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine reports that its Starlink internet connection has stabilized following a week of network limits. These slowed connections had previously impacted the country's military and drone operations.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes, local officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli forces demolished Palestinian homes in Hebron, displacing local families. The demolitions follow the killing of two Israeli soldiers by Palestinian gunmen just days before Israel's election.

Geo-Political.title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
Geo-Political.summary: A man was arrested after starting a fire at Adolf Hitler's former Eagle's Nest retreat in the German Alps. Approximately 200 emergency personnel responded to extinguish the blaze at the historic mountaintop residence.

Geo-Political.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
Geo-Political.summary: Kaylub Giamanco killed a teenage gunman who had fatally shot three children and a teacher at an Oregon school. Giamanco expressed deep anguish because he was unable to save the victims.

Geo-Political.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
Geo-Political.summary: A British woman died in the Bahamas after attempting to rescue her sons who were swept away at sea. Her husband stated that the loss of his childhood sweetheart is unimaginable for their family.

Geo-Political.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis
Geo-Political.summary: Vanessa Trump announced she is cancer-free six months after revealing her breast cancer diagnosis. She shares five children with her ex-husband, Donald Trump Jr.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An experiment testing AI traffic generation revealed that ChatGPT recommended the author's WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This outcome demonstrates a shift from traditional search engine optimization to AI-driven visibility.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide highlights the top ten AI tools designed to make the content creation process easier and more efficient.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audience. Because numerous tools are available on the market, choosing the right one for your specific needs can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money through its platform. The article also provides a list of the best CJ affiliate programs and alternative options.

Data & Insights.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
Data & Insights.summary: Experts state that India must expand its battery storage and modernise its power grid to reach its 500 GW non-fossil fuel capacity target by 2030. As of July 31, 2026, the country has already installed 300.50 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity.

Data & Insights.title: India’s commerce and industry ministry working to identify AI proof sectors: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Indian commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal announced that the government is working to identify economic sectors capable of withstanding artificial intelligence-led disruption. The initiative aims to protect India's industries and workforce from future technological displacement.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: Construction is advancing on the 125-kilometer Rishikesh-Karnaprayag railway line, which will feature 16 tunnels. India is expanding its domestic tunnel boring machine manufacturing capabilities to support this Himalayan connectivity project.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to accelerating manufacturing, services, and easing inflation. However, employment growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Taxing the top one percent of earners is insufficient for solving income inequality on its own. How governments choose to spend public funds is crucial for achieving true economic justice.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. Refiners increased spot cargo purchases as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz rose, easing Iran war-related supply constraints.

India.title: Mystery Mention Of Rs 500 Crore Sparks War Between Allies Shiv Sena, BJP
India.summary: Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange Patil released an audio clip featuring a woman discussing a Rs 500-crore payment meant for him. This revelation has sparked a political clash between allies Shiv Sena and the BJP, while putting Shrikant Shinde in the spotlight over alleged financial ties.

India.title: Himanta Sarma Backs PM's Attack On Congress At NDTV World Summit
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma supported Prime Minister Narendra Modi's criticism of the Congress party at the NDTV World Summit in New Delhi. During the October 22 event, Modi contrasted the global pursuit of a new order with certain individuals' alleged desire for domestic disorder.

India.title: After Jamia, ABVP Claims Umar Khalid, Naxalbari Slogans Painted On JNU Walls
India.summary: The ABVP has claimed that slogans supporting Umar Khalid and Naxalbari were painted on JNU walls following a similar incident at Jamia. Additionally, the group accused AISA president Neha Bora of raising slogans in support of Umar Khalid.

India.title: Economic Hits And Misses Of Donald Trump Ahead Of Midterm Elections
India.summary: Donald Trump's agenda focuses on lowering the cost of living, reviving manufacturing, extending tax cuts, and shrinking the government. It also emphasizes boosting domestic energy production through the "Drill, Baby, Drill" policy ahead of the midterm elections.

India.title: Anti-Dam Violence Spirals In Arunachal, Chief Minister Renews Offer Of Talks
India.summary: Protesters in Arunachal Pradesh ransacked the homes of several prominent politicians amid escalating violence against local dams. Following the unrest, the Chief Minister renewed an offer to hold discussions with the demonstrators.

India.title: "Anti-Hindu": BJP Attacks Congress After Lord Ram Idol Moved From Hyderabad Crossing
India.summary: The BJP accused Congress of being "anti-Hindu" after authorities moved a Lord Ram idol that Hindu groups had installed at a Hyderabad crossing for Vijayadashami. The statue was originally placed at the Basheerbagh Chowrasta before its relocation sparked political controversy.

General.title: Met Police says letter with claims about Meghan's father not shared with other law enforcement
General.summary: The Met said it passed information to the duchess but did not share it with other law enforcement agencies.

General.title: UK braces for worst of Storm Boelo as amber warnings due to come into force
General.summary: Storm Boelo is bringing severe winds to Scotland, northern England, and Northern Ireland. Amber weather warnings are in effect for the region as the country faces its second major storm in two days.

General.title: Between quick wins and big dreams lies Burnham's biggest test
General.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has set long-term goals for the UK up to 2040. However, political commentator Laura Kuenssberg argues that he must first navigate significant political and economic challenges in the near term.

General.title: Mum who died trying to save sons swept away in Bahamas was hero, husband says
General.summary: Leanne Gregory died in the Bahamas after being swept away while trying to save her sons. Her husband, Nathan Gregory, called her a hero and said her loss is unimaginable for their family.

General.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes, local officials say
General.summary: Israeli forces demolished homes belonging to Palestinian families in Hebron following the killing of two Israeli soldiers by Palestinian gunmen. The demolitions occurred just days before Israel's scheduled election.

General.title: Infantino tells BBC Sport he is backed by 'vast majority' of world football
General.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino stated that the vast majority of world football supports him. He also laughed off questions regarding whether he considered resigning over the World Cup sell-off debacle.
